title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: Hold the briefing because it directs readers to availability reports for the feature's regional and language availability, but Microsoft says those reports are retired historical snapshots and must not determine current availability. The roadmap, enablement, licensing and automation claims are supported; three minor corrections would complete the capacity and provider-access instructions.
